'''Jeremy Woolard''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Raleigh tournament]] on 7 July 2001 with crazy alderaan operatives, according to Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2588">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-07-flying-is-fun-raleigh-7-7d2588/ flying-is-fun-raleigh-7-7], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 7 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-07-flying-is-fun-raleigh-7-7d2588/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
